hf_hub_push.detail: DPO adapter and model card were uploaded with the local HF token; the token is not stored in this artifact.

cross_judge.detail: Eight prompt pairs were judged through the real API; full verdicts are in data/eval/cross_judge_openai.json.

wandb_public_run.detail: No W&B API key is available, so no public run URL can be created honestly.

gguf_public_repo_upload.detail: GitHub rejected new LFS objects for this public fork. Q4_K_M and Q5_K_M remain local with hashes and reproducible metadata; no broken pointer commit is kept on the public branch.

mmlu_full_official.detail: The official cais/mmlu dataset and lm-eval harness succeeded for mmlu_abstract_algebra (n=3); the full 57-subject group is CPU-time limited.

official_benchmark_smokes.detail: Official lm-eval GSM8K and IFEval smoke runs completed with n=3 each on CPU; IFEval used max_gen_toks=64. These are smoke results, not full-suite scores.
